استألفن (form X)
# اِسْتَأْلَفْنَ (istaʔlafna) /is.taʔ.laf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
# اِسْتَأْلِفْنَ (istaʔlifna) /is.taʔ.lif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
